scientific_position: The raw 153-decision research ledger and the official frozen monthly CORE profile are distinct objects. The official profile uses the documented V10.4 month-deduplication rule (keep last decision per period_end month). An exact optimizer replay FAIL remains a FAIL even if the economic error is small. A frozen-profile cross-check can independently PASS because it verifies persisted profile construction rather than re-solving the optimizer. Survivorship and exact same-close execution timing remain bounded by the evidence actually present.
